why: Both version-update limits must be held independently while the temporary pause is in force.

mutants.why: A resumed npm version-update stream must fail the temporary-pause oracle.

mutants.anchor:
- package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: "/"
    target-branch: dev
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 0
mutants.replacement:
- package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: "/"
    target-branch: dev
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
mutants.why: A resumed Actions version-update stream must fail the temporary-pause oracle.
